prompt: Which Aseprite version had the patch note: "Added option to enable the 'Snap to Grid' option for the brush preview #4137"?
answer: The patch note appeared in **Aseprite v1.3-rc8**, released **November 16, 2023**. It added the option to enable **Snap to Grid for the brush preview** (issue #4137).
